reply_1: sam: short answer — LB healthchecks go to the Service port unless you set the annotation to override the health check port. If your pod only exposes 9090 you must ensure readinessProbe matches targetPort or add the aws annotation to point healthcheck to 9090. :+1:
reply_2: jules: regarding SecretBinding — Gateway API supports SecretBinding CR, but you can't directly mount a secret from another namespace unless you use a SecretBinding CR that references it (cluster-scoped). Our existing secretbinding controller expects the secret in the same namespace as the Gateway resource. safest is to reconcile a copy in 'inference' ns OR use the teams-cert-sync job we have.
reply_3: maya: thanks — will update readinessProbe to 9090. On the secret copy: prefer using cert-sync job vs manual copy. Tess, any objections to cert-sync for this canary?
